title.en: Massive Nerfs to The Venomous Abyss Raid - Large Nerfs to Ula'tek on Every Difficult
title.es: Nerfs masivos a The Venomous Abyss Banda - Nerfs grandes a Ula 'tek en cada dificultad

summary.en: Massive Nerfs to The Venomous Abyss Raid - Large Nerfs to Ula'tek on Every Difficult...
summary.es: Massive Nerfs to The Venomous Abyss Banda - Large Nerfs to Ula 'tek on Every Difficult...

contentHtml:
Blizzard is applying massive nerfs to many bosses in The Venomous Abyss raid, including Heroic Ula'tek, Mythic Ula'tek, Mythic Vashnik and more!

It's important to note that these nerfs are not coming on the weekly reset and some of them are live now.

Heroic Ula'tek
  • Adjusted difficulty scaling for lower scaling sizes.
  • Removed the number of eggs on each side in Phase 2.
  • Health Reduced.
  • Caustic Waves damage
  • Swirly damage reduced.
  • Reduced the number of eggs in last phase.
  • Reduced the number of red soaks in last phase.
  • Reduced the number of tethers in Phase 2.
Mythic Ula'tek
  • Caustic Waves initial damage now 761k (was 917k) and periodic damage now does 59k (was 540k)
  • Falling Debris now does 1.6M (was 2.5M)
  • Virulent Spit now does 587k (was 918k)
  • Noxious Splash now does 500k initially (was 750k) and 87k periodic damage (was 542k)
  • Putrid Membrane now lasts for 20 seconds
Blizzard
View Original
Greetings, raiders!

We’ll be making a number of adjustments to encounters in the Venomous Abyss over the next few days. You can find the details below and we’ll update hotfixes when they are live.

The Venomous Abyss
  • Entombed Sentinels
    • Reduced the maximum scale of Blood Venom pools on Heroic and Mythic difficulty.
    • Blood Venom pool duration reduced to 2 minutes on Mythic difficulty (was 5 minutes).
  • Vashnik, the Malignant
    • Malignance damage reduced by 37% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Malignance damage over time duration reduced to 16 seconds on Mythic difficulty.
  • Twin Fangs
    • Visceral Burst damage reduced by 40% on Mythic difficulty.
  • The Coiled Altar
    • Axegrinder movement speed reduced by 20% on all difficulties.
    • Axegrinder damage reduced by 20% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Gloombomb damage reduced by 20% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Venom Rupture damage reduced by 15% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Malevolent Resonance damage reduced by 60%.
    • Gravebound Soul Fragments last an additional 2 seconds before fading away on Mythic difficulty.
    • The number of Spiteful Soulcoilers that spawn from Spiritcackle reduced to 1 on Mythic difficulty (was 2).
      • Developers’ notes: With this change Soulcoilers will now spawn similarly to how they spawn on Heroic difficulty.
  • Ula’tek
    • Adjusted the health scaling on the following enemies on Raid Finder, Normal, and Heroic difficulties to better account for smaller raid sizes. Their base health has also been reduced on these difficulties to ensure the health scaling does not increase their health with larger raid sizes.
      • Ula’tek
      • Blightsclae Rawling
      • Blightscale Viper
      • Blightscale Shrieker
      • Weakened Doomscale
    • Ula’tek health reduced by 15% on Heroic difficulty.
    • Unchecked Rage damage reduced by 61% on all difficulties.
    • Caustic Waves impact damage reduced by 17% on Heroic and Mythic difficulties.
    • Caustic Waves damage over time reduced by 75% on Normal, 61% on Heroic, and 89% on Mythic difficulties.
    • Malice damage reduced by 63% on Normal and Heroic difficulty, and 45% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Virulent Spit damage reduced by 46% on Raid Finder, 33% on Normal and Heroic, and 36% on Mythic difficulties.
    • Falling Debris damage reduced by 46% on Raid Finder, 33% on Normal and Heroic, and 36% on Mythic difficulties.
    • Viscous Echoes impact damage reduced by 53% and damage over time reduced by 25% on all difficulties.
    • Reduced the number of eggs summoned by Call of the Serpent on Normal and Heroic difficulty.
    • Reduced the number of targets selected by Serpent’s Bite on all difficulties.
    • Reduced the number of targets selected by Grasping Fangs on Normal and Heroic difficulty.
    • Removed 2 eggs from each side during Phase 2, reducing the total to 8 eggs per side on Heroic difficulty.
    • Ula’tek no longer generates additional Caustic Waves from Spectral Tails when sending walls of waves across the platforms during Phase 3 on Heroic difficulty.
    • Noxious Splash initial damage reduced by 33% and damage over time reduced by 84% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Putrid Membrane duration reduced to 20 seconds (was 30 seconds) on Mythic difficulty.

title.en: Minimum Deposit of 1 Silver Required to List Items on Auction House in WoW: Forever
title.es: Se requiere un depósito mínimo de 1 plata para poner en venta artículos en la casa de subastas en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Minimum Deposit of 1 Silver Required to List Items on Auction House in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Se requiere un depósito mínimo de 1 plata para poner en venta artículos en la casa de subastas en WoW: para siempre...

contentHtml:
In WoW: Forever, listing an item on the Auction House always incurs a deposit of at least 1 silver.

When players list an item on the Auction House, a deposit is required. The deposit is given back to players if the item successfully sells, but is lost if the item is cancelled or the Auction expires. In the original version of WoW, the deposit requirement depends on the item's Vendor Price and the duration:

DurationDeposit Cost
2 Hours5% of Vendor Price
8 Hours20% of Vendor Price
24 Hours60% of Vendor Price


 
Vendor Price of 4 Silver and 61 Copper


In WoW: Forever, there appears to be one more rule: A minimum of 1 Silver is required.

With a Vendor price of 4 Silver and 61 Copper, we would expect an 8-hour listing of this item to require 92 Copper, but this is listed at 1 Silver. Similarly, if you take any cheap vendor item, the Deposit is always listed as 1 Silver. This increased deposit imposes a significant risk to players if the item doesn't sell within the time frame. Many players will likely not be willing to risk a silver to put things on the Auction House for time being, instead vendoring the items. At least in the early game, 1 Silver is a hefty fee to list items on the Auction House if you're afraid that they won't sell. To combat this, you can try to list items in larger stacks or just vendor items to get a guaranteed amount if you're afraid of the risk.

Is This Intended?

On the Beta, this functionality was noticed, but was reported as a bug, as the listed deposit was not showing the correct amount of gold taken from players. On live servers, the deposit now matches. It is still unknown if a minimum deposit is intended, and this may be a result of WoW: Forever using the Retail client. The retail client has a 1 silver minimum deposit, and was in effect in 2018 (oir earlier), as an old blog post references the minimum deposit amount.

title.en: Mythic Twin Fangs Nerf for The Venomous Abyss Raid
title.es: Nerf de colmillos gemelos míticos para The Venomous Abyss Banda

summary.en: Mythic Twin Fangs Nerf for The Venomous Abyss Raid...
summary.es: Nerf de colmillos gemelos míticos para The Venomous Abyss Banda...

contentHtml:
A couple of days after the weekly reset, Mythic Twin Fangs has now been nerfed.

The Twin Fangs


The hotfixes that were just pushed to live servers reduce the penalty for missing an interrupt on the Broodlings of Ithraz. Missing an interrupt almost always killed the group previously, but as players got stronger from gear and the scaling raid buff, it was already possible to heal through one stack of the DoT. Now, with the ability taking a flat 40% nerf to the initial and periodic damage, missing a single interrupt is definitely healable.
Visceral Burst damage reduced by 40%:
  • Now deals 375k damage up initial damage and an additional 125k every sec for 6 sec.
It's important to note that the add will spam cast until it's successfully interrupted, so if you miss a cast, you will still need to interrupt the second cast.

summary.en: Blizzard Investigating Issues with Certain Escort Quests in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Blizzard investiga problemas con ciertas misiones de escolta en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Blizzard is investigating issues with certain quests in WoW: Forever.

BlizzardCS has started writing comments on Wowhead quest pages, noting that certain quests are bugged and that they're investigating the issue.

Escort Quests

BlizzardCS has commented on the quest pages of Freedom to Ruul, Free From the Hold, and The Defias Brotherhood. These are all escort quests that can immediately fail if the quest giver dies or, in this case, despawns.
Blizzard
We're aware that Ruul/Gilthares Firebough/Defias Traitor may disappear when moving near or across zone and area boundaries, causing the quest to fail. We're already investigating the issue.

Undead Paladin Quest

One of the early Undead Paladin quests is Rediscovering the Light, which requires players to rediscover how to use Holy Light. Sometimes healing the NPCs doesn't give progress towards the quest objective and Blizzard is aware of the issue.
Blizzard
View Original
We're aware that healing Injured Deathguards may not grant progress and we're already investigating the issue.

title.en: New Prerequisites Required for Ruins of Lordaeron Dungeon Quests in WoW: Forever
title.es: Nuevos requisitos previos necesarios para las misiones de las mazmorras de las ruinas de Lordaeron en WoW: Forever

summary.en: New Prerequisites Required for Ruins of Lordaeron Dungeon Quests in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Nuevos Prerrequisitos Requeridos para Ruinas de Lordaeron Mazmorra Quests en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Two Horde quests for Ruins of Lordaeron have new prerequisite quests on live servers!

Ruins of Lordaeron DungeonAll Dungeon Quests


Dungeon quests are a very good source of experience in WoW: Forever, as the experience from killing dungeon mobs was nerfed and the amount of experience from dungeon quests were buffed. Ruins of Lordaeron is the second dungeon Horde players are likely to run and when collecting the Dungeon quests, there's a change on the live servers: two of the Horde quests now have a quest chain prerequisite in order to pick them up.

While Alliance players don't have any prerequisites to pick up their quests, The Wrath of Rath'mael and The New Plague now both require a quest chain to be completed when they were previously available right away on Beta.
The Wrath of Rath'mael quest is no longer available from Deathguard Kristof right away. Instead, players have to complete a level 13 quest chain that starts with Rear Guard Patrol at Deathguard Linnea in the Tirisfal Glades, /way 65.4 60.2
  • Rear Guard Patrol - Defeat 8 Bleeding Horror and Wandering Spirit.
  • Rear Guard Patrol - Defeat the level 13 Elite mob Riptear.
Once these quests are complete, the The Wrath of Rath'mael becomes available.
The New Plague quest is no longer available to pick up from Theodore Griffs right away. Players will have to complete a long three-part quest chain that spans both Tirisfal Glades and the Silverpine Forest. There's a lot of running around and a lot of low-drop rate quest items.
  • A Recipe For Death - Collect 6 low drop-rate items from Bears and Spiders and then turn them in in the Undercity.
  • A Recipe For Death - Get back to Silverpine Forest and loot a book from south of the map in an Elite area. Looting the book has a 5 second cast time.
  • A Recipe For Death - Loot many low drop-rate items from level 18 creatures near the lake.
Once you complete all these quests, The New Plague is now available from Theodore Griffs in the Undercity /way 46.6 71.8.

summary.es: The Weekly Reset with Taliesin and Evitel: Forever Forever? Talebound y más...

contentHtml:
Taliesin and Evitel cover the latest news and do a deep dive into pertinent topics in The Weekly Reset. This week, WoW: Forever, where it's going, and how it is different from Retail. Also Talebound, decor, and more.

World of Warcraft Forever launches THIS WEEK! It's going to be an amazing time, a clean slate, a new path... but where will that path lead? If Forever does indeed last for forever, the game is inevitably going to change, so what will it look like in a year? 5 years? 10?

We talk horizontal progression, expansions, and playable races. We look forward to the biggest WoW launch ever, and even find time to talk a bit about Midnight and Talebound too!

Show Topics

  • Planet Azeroth: Episode 1 ft. Bill Bailey
  • Planet Azeroth: Episode 2 ft. Bill Bailey
  • The WoW: Forever Podcast Episode 6 Now Available
  • Name Reservations Included Overly Restrictive Name Check But Fix Incoming
  • Talebound End-Game Player Power Rewards
